title: Vitamix Immersion Blender Whisk
description: Give your forearm a break and take your Vitamix Immersion Blender for a spin. This attachment turns your Immersion blender in a powerful whisk, allowing you to whip aquafaba, batters, meringues, eggs, cream, and more in minutes.
